name: Public Finance Authority Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY OF LA VERNE

  PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY

  AGENDA

  Wednesday, May 15, 2019, 4: 00 p. m.
  Conference Room

  3660 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the Public Financing Authority meetings are welcomed and
appreciated.  Community engagement provides the Authority with valuable information. In
compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Assistant
City Clerk' s Office at ( 909) 596- 8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

1  CALL TO ORDER

  Board Members:  Charlie Rosales, Chair, Elected Member
  Robin Carder, Vice Chair, Elected Member
  Tim Hepburn, Elected Member
  Gilbert Ivey, Member of the Public
  Raymond Skelton, Member of the Public

  Staff:  Robert Russi, City Manager
  Eric Scherer, Director of Community Development
  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, Assistant City Clerk

2.  Approval of Minutes —August 28, 2017 and October 30, 2017

3  Update  on  City' s Enhanced Infrastructure Financing District ( EIFD) status —Staff will
  present the Board with an update on the current status of the EIFD and revenue collected
  to date.

4.  Update  on  Discussions with Los Angeles County — Staff will update the Board on the

  current status of discussions with Los Angeles County Staff on moving forward with
  County' s participation in the EIFD.
  5.  Direction to draft an amendment to the Infrastructure Financing Plan ( IFP) — In order
  for Los Angeles County to consider participating in the EIFD, the IFP will need to be
  amended with new financial studies and potential updates to the list of projects.

  Staff Recommendation:  The Authority Board should direct the Executive Director
  to  prepare  an  amendment  to  the  IFP  pursuant  to
  Government Code Section 53398. 63

 6.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time set aside for anyone

  wishing to address the La Verne Financing Authority on items not listed in any other place
  on the agenda. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited
  from talking or engaging in discussion on any item not appearing on the posted agenda.
  However, your concerns may be referred to staff or set for discussion at a later date. Any
  person desiring to speak should complete a ' Speaker Card' and hand it to the Assistant
  City Clerk. When addressing the Authority, please state your name and address for the
  record. The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments.

 7  ADJOURNMENT

  Posting Statement: A true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on May 9, 2019, the
j bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, CA and on the City' s website
 @ci. laverne. org
